title: Master Mattes® Eyeshadow Palette: The Neutrals
descriptionHtml:
✓ Pressed Powder Formula✓ Medium Coverage✓ Matte Finish✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Without Parabens✓ Without Sulfates SLS & SLES

What it is: A first-of-its-kind neutral-toned eyeshadow palette with 12 creamy, buildable shades curated for every skin tone with a featherlight, matte finish.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also cruelty-free.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Shades can be worn alone or build beautifully to achieve desired depth and dimension.

-Apply lighter shades all over the lid to enhance and open the eye or to highlight the browbone.

-Layer and blend medium shades into crease and outer corner to softly sculpt the eye.

-Apply deeper shades to smoke and define the lash line.

-Shadows double as brow powders for naturally full and filled-in brows. Apply with MAKEUP BY MARIO’s E7 Brush, sold separately.

Ingredients+
MN 1, MN 3, MN 6:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Alumina, Glycerin, Silica, Tocopherol [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Manganese Violet (Ci 77742), Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140)].

MN 2, MN 4, MN 7:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Alumina, Kaolin, Glycerin, Silica, Tocopherol [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Carmine (Ci 75470), Manganese Violet (Ci 77742), Ultramarines (Ci 77007)].

MN 5, MN 11:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Kaolin, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Alumina, Glycerin, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Silica, Tocopherol [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Carmine (Ci 75470), Manganese Violet (Ci 77742), Ultramarines (Ci 77007)].

MN 8, MN 9:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Kaolin, Tocopherol [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Ultramarines (Ci 77007)].

MN 10:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Silica, Tocopherol [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163)].

MN 12:
Talc, Zinc Stearate, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Dimethicone, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hdi/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Tocopherol, Silica [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Iron Oxides (Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Black 2 Ci 77266 (Nano)].
